name: Nago Kurumi
source:
A female teacher who relocated to Hoshimi Island several years ago.
She teaches at the island's sole integrated elementary and junior high school, where nearly all local youths were once her students.
As a bright and cheerful woman who treats others with love, she is both reliable and intelligent.
Having grown up on Okinawa Main Island, she deeply appreciates the charm of Hoshimi Island from an outsider's perspective.
